explanation: In the xz-plane, y=0, so the trace is (x-3)²/16+z²=1. This ellipse has semi-axes √16=4 and 1 and center (x,z)=(3,0).

answers.correct_value: An ellipse with semi-axes $4$ and $1,$ centered at $(3,0)$ in the $xz$-plane
answers.wrong_value: An ellipse with semi-axes $4$ and $1,$ centered at $(0,0)$ in the $xz$-plane
